players.product: AI-Native Cloud: inference cloud (Inference Engine, serverless inference) and GPU Droplets on NVIDIA HGX and AMD Instinct GPUs, integrated with its Core Cloud

quarterly_data.signal: 10-K customer concentration: DigitalOcean says it has no material customer concentration - its top 25 customers made up approximately 10%, 8% and 7% of revenue in 2025, 2024 and 2023, and no customer accounted for 10% or more of total revenue in any of those years. Customers spending above $1M (more than $83,333 a month) generated $96,250 thousand, 11% of 2025 revenue (6% in 2024); their count rose to 41 from 24, and Digital Native Enterprise customers numbered 21,361 (18,468). ARR was $970 million in 2025, from $820 million in 2024 and $723 million in 2023.
quarterly_data.figure: top 25 customers approximately 10% of 2025 revenue; $1M+ customers 11% of revenue (41 customers); ARR $970 million

quarterly_data.signal: 10-K backlog: as of December 31, 2025 the transaction price allocated to remaining performance obligations was $134,085 thousand with a weighted-average life of 2.0 years; DigitalOcean expected to recognize $72,799 thousand of it as revenue over the next 12 months.
quarterly_data.figure: RPO $134,085 thousand at December 31, 2025 (weighted-average life 2.0 years)

quarterly_data.signal: 10-K data-center build-out: 2025 revenue was $901,427 thousand (+15%). Cost of revenue rose with $28.6 million higher co-location costs as a result of data center expansions and $7.8 million higher depreciation and amortization; gross profit stayed at 60%. 2025 capital expenditures for property and equipment were $129,086 thousand (2024: $178,167 thousand) plus $126,829 thousand of cash payments for the acquisition of equipment under financing arrangements. In 2025 DigitalOcean released Gradient AI GPUs from AMD and NVIDIA.
quarterly_data.figure: 2025 capex (property and equipment) $129,086 thousand; equipment acquired under financing arrangements $126,829 thousand; co-location costs +$28.6 million
